Professional Experience  
As a junior DevOps engineer at NexaTech Solutions, I focused on streamlining deployment processes and enhancing system reliability. My work on Kubernetes clusters reduced deployment latency by 30% across microservices, while implementing Prometheus-based monitoring improved incident resolution time by 40%. At InnoDev Labs, I supported the migration of monolithic applications to containerized architectures, contributing to a 25% reduction in infrastructure costs. I also automated repetitive tasks using Bash scripts, which freed up 15 hours monthly for the team.  

Technical Skills  
CI/CD pipelines: Designed and maintained workflows for 12+ projects, integrating with GitHub Actions and Jenkins to ensure 99.9% deployment success rates. Optimized pipeline stages to cut build times by 20% for critical applications.  
Kubernetes: Managed deployments for 8+ services, ensuring high availability and auto-scaling. Resolved pod scheduling issues that caused 15% downtime reduction.  
Monitoring & alerting: Built dashboards with Grafana to track system metrics, enabling proactive troubleshooting and reducing unplanned outages by 35%.  
Prometheus/Grafana: Integrated metrics collection across 50+ nodes, providing real-time insights that improved resource utilization by 22%.  
ArgoCD: Automated continuous delivery for 6+ applications, ensuring zero-downtime updates during peak traffic periods.  
Bash: Developed scripts to automate configuration management, reducing manual effort for 10+ recurring tasks.  
GitHub Actions: Streamlined CI workflows for 15+ repositories, ensuring 100% test coverage and faster feedback loops.  
Jenkins: Maintained legacy CI systems, resolving 12+ integration issues that improved build stability.  

Projects  
Led the migration of a legacy monorepo to a modular architecture, resulting in 30% faster deployments and easier maintenance. Automated environment provisioning using Terraform, cutting setup time by 50% for new developers.
